message.content:
The reported input cell is a six-atom parallelepiped whose three edge lengths are essentially alike in magnitude but not treated as identical: [[param:cell.a]], [[param:cell.b]], and [[param:cell.c]] are recorded separately, with the second length differing only at the finest supplied precision. Its angles are strongly non-orthogonal—[[param:cell.alpha]] and [[param:cell.beta]] are obtuse, while [[param:cell.gamma]] is acute—so the submitted geometry should be read as a deliberately skewed input setting rather than as the ideal orthorhombic metric. The contained input motif has [[param:input.atom_count]] atoms and the input stoichiometry is given by [[param:composition.Cu]], [[param:composition.Sr]], and [[param:composition.O]].

After transformation into the public standard setting, the symmetry is the body-centered orthorhombic group identified by [[param:space_group.number]] and the Hall symbol [[param:space_group.hall]]. The mapping from the supplied input frame to that standard frame is carried by [[param:frame.matrix]], with no translational displacement in [[param:frame.origin_shift]]; thus the reorientation is purely a change of basis about the same origin. Input fractional coordinates were rounded according to [[param:round_digits]], and no separate precision-correction entries were supplied, so there are no additional empirical deviations to layer onto the idealized backbone beyond the recorded input metric and frame conversion.

The independent structure consists of four Wyckoff orbits. Strontium occupies a fourfold orbit, [[param:orbit.o000.id]], with element assignment [[param:orbit.o000.element]] on Wyckoff label [[param:orbit.o000.wyckoff]]; its representative lies on the fixed line (1/2, 0, z) and its only free coordinate is the z parameter [[param:orbit.o000.parameters]]. Copper is fixed on a twofold orbit, [[param:orbit.o001.id]], with [[param:orbit.o001.element]] at label [[param:orbit.o001.wyckoff]], corresponding to the fully constrained representative position (1/2, 0, 1/2). One oxygen orbit is likewise fixed, [[param:orbit.o002.id]], with [[param:orbit.o002.element]] on [[param:orbit.o002.wyckoff]] at the origin-type representative (0, 0, 0). The remaining oxygen atoms form another fourfold orbit, [[param:orbit.o003.id]], with [[param:orbit.o003.element]] on the same Wyckoff family label [[param:orbit.o003.wyckoff]] as strontium and the same (1/2, 0, z) freedom, but at a different independent height given by [[param:orbit.o003.parameters]]. Spatially, this places two parameter-bearing sheets along the same x = 1/2, y = 0 line, distinguished by their z values, while the copper and one oxygen sublattice remain pinned at special positions; together the four independent orbits generate the body-centered standard-cell content implied by their multiplicities.
